name: scroll-carousel
title: Scroll Carousel
description: A 3D ring of pictures that turns as you scroll, driven by a CSS scroll timeline, with a scroll-listener fallback and a flat strip under reduced motion.
author: Jhey <https://codepen.io/jh3y>
docs:
Installed `ScrollCarousel` in `components/ui/` (with its stylesheet next to it), plus the `use-reduced-motion` hook in `hooks/`.

```tsx
import { ScrollCarousel } from "@/components/ui/scroll-carousel";

<ScrollCarousel
  images={[{ src: "/a.jpg", alt: "A red door" }, ...]}
  label="Recent work"
  className="h-dvh"
/>
```

It fills its parent, so give the parent a height. Pass 3 or more images, each with `alt` text (an empty string marks a decorative one). The ring turns as the named scroll region over it scrolls (focus it and use the arrow keys); the picture size follows the component's own box, or set `--scroll-carousel-item-size`.

Where the browser has CSS scroll timelines the ring is turned by the stylesheet alone; elsewhere a scroll listener turns it the same way (`scrollDriver="script"` forces that). Under reduced motion nothing is tied to the scroll position: the ring becomes a flat strip of the same images that scrolls natively.
